steps.warmUp: Start with the warm-up, as in every singing lesson: a few easy minutes to wake up your voice.
steps.melisma: Sometimes one syllable is sung over two notes or more: that’s a melisma. Under the notes, a line after the syllable shows it’s held, as in “A-ma-zing”, where “zing” moves over two notes. Keep the same vowel as the notes change, and move gently from one to the next.
steps.graceWait: “Amazing Grace”, in 3/4, waiting at each note: look out for the syllables held over two notes.
steps.graceAlong: Now in time, with the piano. Count three beats in each bar, and let the long notes last their whole length.
steps.more: Song practice has every song with words, from “Hot Cross Buns” to “Jingle Bells”, each moved to fit your voice. Choose the language of the words there, and sing them as often as you like.
